name: saygoal
description: The /dec, /judge, /retro and /repo-audit slash commands — declarative reframing of a request into a /goal contract, contract-anchored acceptance of claimed-done work (re-runs the verification, audits the diff, verdicts VERIFIED / VERIFIED WITH CAVEATS / REFUTED), a stalled-loop retro that rewrites the contract from the transcript, plus a read-only repo audit emitting /goal-ready tasks. Pair with Claude Code's built-in /goal (v2.1.139+). Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) localization fork of forrestchang/andrej-karpathy-skills.
